purpose: Ye form apna address badalwane ke liye hai. Isme aap naya address aur uska proof dete ho.

fields.what_to_fill: Wahi naam likho jo aapke ID proof par hai, spelling same rakho.
DD/MM/YYYY format mein, ID proof ke hisaab se.
House number, gali, area, city, state aur PIN code poora likho.

fields.meaning: Jo naya pata aap register karwana chahte ho
fields.what_to_fill: Address proof document par jaisa likha hai bilkul waisa likho.
Aisa number do jo aap use karte ho, OTP aa sakta hai.

fields.meaning: Aap confirm karte ho ki jankari sahi hai
fields.what_to_fill: Box ke andar hi sign karo, bahar nahi.

common_mistakes: Naam ki spelling ID proof se alag likh dena
Address proof par jo address hai usse alag address likh dena
steps: Saare documents ki saaf photocopy ya scan ready rakho
Form capital letters mein, kaale ya neele pen se bharo
Naya address proof ke hisaab se likho
Form aur documents jama karo aur receipt sambhal ke rakho
